name: DatePicker
purpose: A single-date calendar inside a focus-managed popover.
description: Choose a calendar date with keyboard navigation and clear feedback.

guidance.overview: A single-date calendar inside a focus-managed popover.
usage: Use disabledDates to express unavailable dates and timeZone when the date belongs to a particular calendar zone.
Selection commits immediately and closes the popover. Supplying value, even as undefined, makes selection controlled.
accessibility: React DayPicker supplies calendar keyboard navigation and focuses the calendar on opening.
The trigger supports Field label, description, required, and invalid metadata; its label also includes the selected date.
context: Use for a due date or a single calendar date; use TimeRangePicker for relative periods or timestamp intervals.
